notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separate upper-cabinet door leaves and two separate drawers. The exact ordering and midpoint of the two cabinet-door closures is less certain because the doors and the user's hands partially occlude one another.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both separate doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens the wide drawer left of the stove and the wide drawer right of the stove. The cabinet doors and drawers remain open during further camera movement before each is later closed.
